hook: deny hard rm -rf /.stdout: {"status":"deny","reason":"[Auto Guard] ⛔ 拦截 [黑名单]: Recursive delete of root is always denied"}

hook: two-phase dir delete.stdout: {"status":"deny","reason":"[Auto Guard] ⛔ 拦截 [删除复核]: 目录删除需要理由。请附带 [删除理由] <理由> 重试同一命令（已记录命令：rm -rf ./build） 如需继续，请在原命令后附带 [删除理由] <你的理由> 重试；理由将由 LLM 复核。"}

hook: sensitive ask .env edit.stdout: {"status":"ask","reason":"[Auto Guard] ❓ 询问 [敏感路径]: Path is on the sensitive list, confirmation required: D:/w/.env"}

hook: unreviewable bash empty input.stdout: {"status":"ask","reason":"无法读取 bash 命令参数（metadata/patterns 均缺失），保守起见需要人工确认"}

hook: unreviewable edit no path.stdout: {"status":"ask","reason":"无法读取 edit 目标路径（metadata/patterns 均缺失），保守起见需要人工确认"}

hook: bad stdin.stdout: {"status":"ask","reason":"auto-guard：无法解析 hook 输入（stdin 不是合法 JSON），保守起见需要人工确认"}
